adjudication.rationale: The PR diff does introduce a verifiable defect: `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` in `admin-group.js.es6`, which is incorrect when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50 -> 3 pages instead of 2). Combined with `next` clamping `offset` to `user_count`, this allows navigating to an extra empty page (offset==user_count yields no members, while `currentPage` becomes the bogus last page). Therefore the “no findings” conclusion is false.
